questions.text: 'वेनगार्ड इंक' पुरुषों, महिलाओं एवं बच्चों के लिए फुटवियर बनाने वाली एक कम्पनी है और पिछले कुछ वर्षों से लगातार लाभ अर्जित कर रही है। इसकी कार्य करने की शैली लोकतांत्रिक है। संगठन में सुधार के लिए कर्मचारियों को योजनाएँ विकसित करने एवं उन्हें कार्यान्वित करने के लिए उत्साहित किया जाता है। वरुण, जो उत्पादन विभाग में कार्यरत है, ने एक सुझाव दिया जिससे जूतों की उत्पादन लागत में 10% कमी आ गई। उसे उसके सुझाव के लिए पुरस्कृत किया गया। उपरोक्त स्थिति में 'वेनगार्ड इंक' द्वारा पालन किए गए प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्त को पहचानिए:
questions.text_english: 'Vanguard Inc.', a company manufacturing footwear for men, women and children has been earning consistent profits for the last many years. It has a democratic style of working. Workers are encouraged to develop and carry out plans for improvement in the organisation. Varun who is working in the production department gave a suggestion which resulted in 10% reduction in the cost of production of shoes. He was rewarded for his suggestion. Identify the principle of management followed by 'Vanguard Inc.' in the above case:

options.B: सामूहिक हितों के लिए व्यक्तिगत हितों का समर्पण

options_english.B: Subordination of Individual Interest to General Interest

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Initiative. Fayol's principle of Initiative states that employees should be encouraged to develop and execute plans for improvement. In this case, Vanguard Inc. encourages its workers to develop and carry out plans for improvement, and Varun was rewarded for suggesting a method that reduced production cost by 10%. This perfectly reflects the principle of Initiative. Option A (Esprit De Corps) refers to team spirit, Option B refers to giving priority to organisational interest over personal interest, and Option D (Equity) refers to fair and just treatment of employees.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) पहल-क्षमता है। फेयोल के पहल-क्षमता के सिद्धान्त के अनुसार कर्मचारियों को योजनाएँ विकसित करने और उन्हें कार्यान्वित करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाना चाहिए। यहाँ 'वेनगार्ड इंक' के कर्मचारियों को सुधार की योजनाएँ बनाने हेतु उत्साहित किया जाता है और वरुण को उसके सुझाव के लिए पुरस्कृत किया गया।

questions.text: 'चाइल्ड-ओ' एक वस्त्र निर्माणी कम्पनी है जो बच्चों के अद्वितीय एवं सजीले डिज़ाइन वाले कपड़े बनाती है। नायशा 'चाइल्ड-ओ' के साथ एक मानव संसाधन प्रबंधक के रूप में कार्यरत थी। अच्छे वेतन एवं अन्य बहुत प्रकार के लाभों को देने के बाद भी कम्पनी कर्मचारियों की बहुत ऊँची आवर्त समस्या का सामना कर रही है। नायशा ने इसका कारण जानने का प्रयास किया लेकिन वह उसको ढूँढ नहीं पायी। मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी की अनुमति से नायशा ने इसका कारण ढूँढने के लिए एक व्यक्ति की नियुक्ति की। यह पाया गया कि 'चाइल्ड-ओ' की अपेक्षा अन्य संगठन अपने कर्मचारियों को अधिक स्वायत्तता एवं अधिकार प्रदान कर रहे थे जिससे कर्मचारी यह अनुभव करते थे कि उनका कार्य महत्वपूर्ण था। इससे 'चाइल्ड-ओ' के कर्मचारी इन संगठनों की ओर आकर्षित हो रहे थे। वह प्रोत्साहन, जिसके कारण 'चाइल्ड-ओ' के कर्मचारी अन्य संगठनों की ओर आकर्षित हो रहे थे, हैं:
questions.text_english: 'Child-O' is a garment manufacturing company which makes clothes with unique and stylish designs for children. Naisha was working as the Human Resource Manager with 'Child-O'. Inspite of good pay and many other benefits offered, the company is facing problem of high turnover of its employees. Naisha tried to find out the reason but could not. She appointed a person with the permission of the Chief Executive Officer to find out the reason. It was found that other organisations were giving more autonomy and authority to their employees which made them feel that their jobs were important. This was attracting the employees of 'Child-O' to other organisations. The incentive which attracted the employees of 'Child-O' to other organisations is:

options.A: कर्मचारियों को पहचान देने सम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Employee Empowerment. Employee Empowerment refers to giving employees greater autonomy and authority to make decisions related to their work, which makes them feel important and valued. In the case, it was specifically found that other organisations were giving more autonomy and authority to their employees, making them feel their jobs mattered. This is exactly the definition of Employee Empowerment. Option A refers to recognising employees publicly, Option B refers to involving employees in decision-making processes, and Option C refers to providing growth and promotion opportunities.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) कर्मचारियों का सशक्तिकरण है। कर्मचारी सशक्तिकरण का अर्थ है कर्मचारियों को अधिक स्वायत्तता और अधिकार देना। प्रश्न में स्पष्ट रूप से कहा गया है कि अन्य संगठन अपने कर्मचारियों को अधिक स्वायत्तता एवं अधिकार दे रहे थे।

questions.text: 'चूँकि व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण में विभिन्न स्रोतों से उत्पन्न होने वाली अनेक पारस्परिक सम्बन्धित एवं गतिशील स्थितियाँ अथवा शक्तियाँ सम्मिलित होती हैं, इसलिए तुरंत यह समझना कठिन हो जाता है कि दिया गया पर्यावरण किन तत्त्वों से बना है? अत: पर्यावरण को अलग-अलग भागों में समझना अपेक्षाकृत सरल है परन्तु समग्र रूप से समझना कठिन है।' उपरोक्त में प्रकाशित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण की विशेषता की पहचान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: 'Since business environment consists of numerous interrelated and dynamic conditions or forces which arise from different sources, it becomes difficult to comprehend at once what exactly constitutes a given environment'. Thus it is relatively easier to understand the environment in parts but difficult to grasp in its totality. Identify the feature of business environment highlighted above:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Complexity. The complexity of business environment means that it consists of numerous interrelated and dynamic forces from different sources, making it very difficult to comprehend in totality. One can understand each component separately but understanding the whole environment at once is extremely challenging. This is precisely what the statement describes. Option A (Uncertainty) refers to difficulty in predicting future changes, Option C (Relativity) refers to the environment varying across regions, and Option D (Dynamic nature) refers to the environment constantly changing.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) जटिलता है। व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण की जटिलता का अर्थ है कि इसमें विभिन्न स्रोतों से उत्पन्न अनेक पारस्परिक सम्बन्धित एवं गतिशील शक्तियाँ होती हैं जिन्हें समग्र रूप में समझना कठिन होता है।

questions.text: नमन तथा विनीत बचपन के दोस्त थे और दोनों 'सनशाइन क्रोकरी' में कार्यरत थे। नमन मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी के रूप में कार्यरत था तथा विनीत उत्पादन प्रबन्धक था। वे अधिकांशत: कम्पनी सम्बन्धी मुद्दों पर दोपहर के भोजन के समय या इकट्ठे यात्रा करते समय चर्चा करते थे। हाल ही में कम्पनी को शौर्य होटल से 5000 डिनर सैट की पूर्ति का आदेश मिला। यह एक अनपेक्षित आदेश था तथा इससे कम्पनी के आगम में वृद्धि होनी थी। इस आदेश की सूचना नमन ने इंटरकॉम द्वारा विनीत को दी। विनीत ने दी गई समय अवधि में इस आदेश को निष्पादित कर दिया। इसके लिए नमन द्वारा उसकी प्रशंसा की गई। सम्प्रेषण का वह प्रकार जिसका प्रयोग नमन द्वारा विनीत को आदेश सम्प्रेषित करने के लिए किया गया था, वह था:
questions.text_english: Naman and Vineet were childhood friends and both were working in 'Sunshine Crockery.' Naman was working as the Chief Executive Officer while Vineet was the Production Manager. They would generally discuss company related issues over lunch-time or while travelling together. The company had recently received an order for supply of 5,000 dinner sets from Shaurya Hotel. It was an unexpected order and would increase the revenue of the company. This order was communicated by Naman to Vineet over intercom. Vineet executed the order within the given time period. For this, he was appreciated by Naman. The type of communication used by Naman to communicate the order to Vineet was:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Formal Communication. When Naman communicated the order to Vineet over the intercom in his capacity as Chief Executive Officer to the Production Manager, this was formal communication because it followed the official chain of command and was work-related. The fact that they were childhood friends and discussed issues informally during lunch is irrelevant to the specific act of communicating the order through official channels (intercom). Formal communication flows through the officially designated channels of an organisation. Options B, C, and D do not apply because the intercom communication was official and hierarchical.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) औपचारिक सम्प्रेषण है। नमन ने इंटरकॉम के माध्यम से मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी की हैसियत से उत्पादन प्रबन्धक को आदेश दिया जो कि आधिकारिक श्रृंखला के माध्यम से औपचारिक सम्प्रेषण है।

questions.text: कथन – I : शेयर बाज़ार का आधारभूत कार्य एक ऐसे सतत् बाज़ार का सृजन करना है जहाँ प्रतिभूतियों को खरीदा और बेचा जाता है। कथन – II : शेयर बाज़ार विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को द्रवता एवं आसान विनियोग दोनों ही उपलब्ध कराता है। निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Statement-I: The basic function of a Stock Exchange is the creation of a continuous market where securities are bought and sold.
Statement-II: The Stock Exchange provides both liquidity and easy marketability to already existing securities in the market.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement-I is true and Statement-II is false.
options_english.B: Statement-II is true and Statement-I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is correct because the primary function of a Stock Exchange is indeed the creation of a continuous market where investors can buy and sell securities at any time during trading hours. Statement II is also correct because the Stock Exchange provides liquidity (ability to convert securities into cash quickly) and easy marketability (ability to buy or sell securities without difficulty) to existing securities. Both statements accurately describe functions of a Stock Exchange, so both are true.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। कथन I सही है क्योंकि शेयर बाज़ार का मूल कार्य एक सतत् बाज़ार का सृजन करना है। कथन II भी सही है क्योंकि शेयर बाज़ार द्रवता एवं आसान विनियोग दोनों प्रदान करता है।

questions.text: प्लास्टिक अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन नियम 2022 के अनुसार 1 जुलाई, 2022 से दिल्ली में एकल उपयोग प्लास्टिक की वस्तुएँ प्रतिबंधित थी। यहाँ संदर्भित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का आयाम है ________।
questions.text_english: As per Plastic Waste Management Rule 2022, single use plastic items were prohibited in Delhi from 1st July, 2022. The dimension of business environment referred to here is ________.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Legal environment. The Plastic Waste Management Rule 2022 is a law enacted by the government that prohibits single-use plastics. Laws, regulations, and rules enacted by the government form part of the Legal environment of business. Businesses must comply with such regulations or face penalties. Option A (Economic environment) relates to economic conditions like GDP, inflation etc., Option C (Technological environment) relates to technological changes and innovations, and Option D (Political environment) relates to political stability and government policies rather than specific enacted laws.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) विधिक पर्यावरण है। प्लास्टिक अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन नियम 2022 एक कानून है जो सरकार द्वारा बनाया गया है। सरकार द्वारा बनाए गए कानून, नियम एवं विनियम विधिक पर्यावरण का हिस्सा हैं।
questions.topic: Dimensions of Business Environment - Legal Environment

questions.text: कथन – I : अभिप्रेरणा सकारात्मक अथवा नकारात्मक हो सकती है। कथन – II : अभिप्रेरणा एक जटिल प्रक्रिया है क्योंकि मनुष्यों की अपेक्षाओं, उनके अवबोधन तथा प्रतिक्रियाओं में भिन्नता होती है। निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Statement-I: Motivation can be either positive or negative.
Statement-II: Motivation is a complex process as the individuals are heterogeneous in their expectations, perceptions and reactions.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement-I is true and Statement-II is false.
options_english.B: Statement-II is true and Statement-I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is true because motivation can indeed be positive (offering rewards, incentives, praise) or negative (threat of punishment, demotion). Statement II is also true because motivation is a complex psychological process since every individual is different in terms of their needs, expectations, perceptions, and reactions. What motivates one employee may not motivate another. Therefore, both statements correctly describe the nature of motivation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। कथन I सत्य है क्योंकि अभिप्रेरणा सकारात्मक (पुरस्कार) अथवा नकारात्मक (दण्ड का भय) दोनों हो सकती है। कथन II भी सत्य है क्योंकि मनुष्यों की अपेक्षाएँ, अवबोधन और प्रतिक्रियाएँ भिन्न होती हैं।

questions.text: नव्या किराने का सामान खरीदने के लिए सुपर बाज़ार गई। उसने सुपर बाज़ार से बाजरे का एक किलो आटा खरीदा। घर पहुँचकर जब उसने पैकेट खोला, तो उसने पाया कि उसमें कीड़े थे। वह बहुत निराश हुई और इस बारे में उसने अपने बेटे को बताया। उसके बेटे ने उसे लेबल की जाँच करने को कहा। जब उसने पैकेट पर लगे हुए लेबल को जाँचा तो उसने पाया कि बाजरे का आटा पुराना था और उसकी उपयोग तिथि निकल चुकी थी। उसने सुपर बाज़ार के विक्रयकर्ता से सम्पर्क किया जिसने तुरंत बाजरे का आटा बदल कर दे दिया। जब उसने विक्रयकर्ता का धन्यवाद किया तो उसे बताया गया कि उपभोक्ताओं को संतुष्ट रखना सुपर बाज़ार की नीति थी। उसने पुन: बताया कि संतुष्ट उपभोक्ताओं से न केवल बार-बार विक्रय को बढ़ावा मिलता है, अपितु वे संभावित उपभोक्ताओं को भी अच्छी प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं जिससे व्यवसाय को अपना उपभोक्ता-आधार बढ़ाने में सहायता मिलती है। सुपर बाज़ार के दृष्टिकोण से उपभोक्ता संरक्षण के महत्त्व के बिन्दु की पहचान कीजिए जो उन्हें उपभोक्ता-आधार को बढ़ाने में सहायता कर रहा है।
questions.text_english: Navya went to a supermarket for grocery shopping. She bought one kg of bajra flour from the supermarket. On reaching home when she opened the packet she found worms inside it. She was disappointed and told her son about the same. Her son asked her to check the label. When she checked the label of the packet, she found that bajra flour was stale and beyond the expiry date. She approached the sales-person at the supermarket who replaced the bajra flour immediately. When she thanked the sales-person, she was told that it was the policy of the supermarket to satisfy the customers. He further told that satisfied customers not only lead to repeat sales but they also provide good feedback to prospective customers which helps in increasing the customer base of business. Identify the point of importance of consumer protection from the point of view of the supermarket which is helping them to increase the customer base:

options_english.A: Long term interest of the business

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Long term interest of the business. The supermarket replaced the product and explained that satisfied customers lead to repeat sales and good word-of-mouth, helping increase the customer base. This is clearly a business strategy aimed at the long-term interest of the business — retaining customers and growing the customer base over time. Option B (Moral justification) refers to the ethical duty to treat customers fairly, Option C (Social responsibility) refers to obligations towards society at large, and Option D (Government intervention) refers to legal compulsion to protect consumers.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) व्यवसाय का दीर्घ अवधिक हित है। सुपर बाज़ार का उद्देश्य संतुष्ट उपभोक्ताओं के माध्यम से बार-बार बिक्री और उपभोक्ता आधार बढ़ाना था जो व्यवसाय के दीर्घकालिक हित को दर्शाता है।
questions.topic: Importance of Consumer Protection - Long term Business Interest

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सामाजिक पर्यावरण का एक घटक नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not an element of social environment?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Rates of saving and investment. Rates of saving and investment are components of the Economic environment, not the social environment. Social environment includes factors related to society such as composition of family (Option A), consumption habits and lifestyles (Option B), and educational system and literacy rates (Option D). Economic environment, on the other hand, includes factors like GDP, inflation, income levels, savings rates, and investment patterns.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) बचतों एवं विनियोग की दरें है। बचत एवं विनियोग की दरें आर्थिक पर्यावरण का हिस्सा हैं, न कि सामाजिक पर्यावरण का। परिवार की संरचना, उपभोग की आदतें तथा शैक्षणिक पद्धति सामाजिक पर्यावरण के घटक हैं।
questions.topic: Dimensions of Business Environment - Social vs Economic Environment

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही का चयन कीजिए:
अभिकथन (A) : पट्टेदारी सुविधाओं की उपलब्धता स्थायी परिसम्पत्तियों में निधियों के निवेश की आवश्यकता को कम कर सकती है और इस प्रकार स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकता कम हो जाती है।
कारण (R): जब एक सम्पत्ति पट्टे पर ली जाती है तो क्रेता फर्म इसके उपयोग के लिए विक्रेता को पट्टेदारी किराया देती है तथा इसे क्रय करने के लिए आवश्यक बड़ी राशि निवेश करने से बच जाती है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements:
Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from those given below:
Assertion (A): Availability of leasing facilities may reduce the funds required to be invested in fixed assets thereby reducing the fixed capital requirements.
Reason (R): When an asset is taken on lease, the firm pays lease rentals to use it and avoids to invest huge sums required to purchase it.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परंतु कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). The Assertion is true: when leasing facilities are available, a firm does not need to purchase fixed assets outright, thereby reducing fixed capital requirements. The Reason correctly explains why: on a lease, the firm only pays periodic rental charges instead of investing a large lump sum to buy the asset. The Reason directly explains the mechanism behind the Assertion, making it the correct explanation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन सत्य है: पट्टेदारी सुविधाएँ स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकता को कम करती हैं। कारण भी सत्य है और यह स्पष्ट करता है कि पट्टे पर सम्पत्ति लेने पर फर्म को केवल किराया देना होता है, बड़ी राशि का निवेश नहीं करना पड़ता।

questions.text: कॉलम-I में दी गई शब्दावली का कॉलम-II में दिए गए उनके अर्थ से मिलान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Match the terms given in Column-I with their meaning in Column-II.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C): a-(ii), b-(iv), c-(i), d-(iii). Trademark (a) is a brand or part of a brand given legal protection — (ii). Brand name (b) is the part of the brand that can be spoken, like 'Nike' or 'Tata' — (iv). Brand (c) is the broader concept — a name, term, sign, symbol, design or combination used to identify and differentiate products from competitors — (i). Brand mark (d) is that part of the brand which can be recognised visually (like a logo or symbol) but cannot be spoken or uttered — (iii).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: a-(ii), b-(iv), c-(i), d-(iii). ट्रेड मार्क को कानूनी संरक्षण प्राप्त होता है। ब्राण्ड नाम का उच्चारण किया जा सकता है। ब्राण्ड उत्पाद की पहचान एवं भिन्नता के लिए प्रयुक्त संयोजन है। ब्राण्ड मार्क पहचाना जा सकता है किन्तु बोला नहीं जा सकता।
questions.topic: Branding - Brand, Brand Name, Brand Mark, Trademark

questions.text: 'कानन्द लिमिटेड' भारत सरकार की 'मेक इन इंडिया' पहल के अन्तर्गत वर्ष 2014 से आरम्भ की गई एक ऑटोमोबाइल निर्माणी कम्पनी है। भविष्य में अधिक विकास की संभावना के कारण इसने सरकार द्वारा प्रदान की गई आर्थिक सहायता का लाभ उठाते हुए वर्तमान वर्ष में उच्च क्षमता का विकास किया। इससे 'कानन्द लिमिटेड' को संभावित अधिक माँग को शीघ्रता से पूरा करने में मदद मिलेगी। इसके लिए 'कानन्द लिमिटेड' ने स्थायी सम्पत्तियों में अधिक मात्रा में निवेश किया फलस्वरूप अधिक मात्रा में स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकता हुई। 'कानन्द लिमिटेड' द्वारा संभावित अधिक माँग को शीघ्रता से पूरा करने के लिए स्थायी पूँजी आवश्यकताओं को प्रभावित करने वाले जिस घटक को ध्यान में रखा गया था उसे पहचानिए।
questions.text_english: 'Kanand Ltd.' is an automobile manufacturing company started in 2014 under 'Make in India' initiative of the Government of India. Expecting higher growth in future, it developed higher capacity in the current year taking advantage of the subsidies provided by the government. This would enable 'Kanand Ltd.' to meet anticipated higher demand quickly. For this, 'Kanand Ltd.' invested large amounts in fixed assets leading to higher requirements of fixed capital. Identify the factor affecting fixed capital requirements which 'Kanand Ltd.' kept in mind to meet higher anticipated demand quicker.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Growth prospects. Kanand Ltd. invested heavily in fixed assets to build higher capacity in anticipation of higher future demand and growth. This is a classic example of the Growth prospects factor — when a company expects high growth in future, it invests more in fixed assets to create capacity in advance so it can meet that demand quickly. Option A (Scale of operations) refers to current production volume, Option B (Nature of business) refers to manufacturing vs trading etc., and Option C (Diversification) refers to entering new product lines.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) विकास प्रत्याशा है। भविष्य में अधिक विकास की उम्मीद में 'कानन्द लिमिटेड' ने उच्च क्षमता विकसित की। विकास प्रत्याशा के कारण कम्पनियाँ स्थायी सम्पत्तियों में अधिक निवेश करती हैं।

questions.text: बहुत से प्रसिद्ध व्यावसायिक संगठन आवेदकों से प्राप्त आवेदनों के लिए अपने कार्यालयों में अनियमित आवेदकों को एक डेटाबेस में रखते हैं। नौकरी के इच्छुक ऐसे व्यक्ति मानव-शक्ति के महत्वपूर्ण स्रोत हो सकते हैं। नौकरी के इच्छुक ऐसे लोगों की एक सूची तैयार की जा सकती है तथा जाँच परख करके किसी भी पद के रिक्त होने पर उसे भरा जा सकता है। उपरोक्त में चर्चित भर्ती का स्रोत है:
questions.text_english: Many reputed business organisations keep a database of unsolicited applicants in their offices. Such job seekers can be a valuable source of manpower. A list of such job seekers can be prepared and can be screened to fill the vacancies as they arise. The source of recruitment discussed above is:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Casual callers. Casual callers are job seekers who approach organisations on their own without any specific vacancy being advertised. Organisations maintain a database of such unsolicited applicants and screen them when vacancies arise. This is an internal/direct source of recruitment. Option A (Direct recruitment) involves putting notices at factory gates for unskilled jobs, Option C (Labour contractors) involves using contractors to supply workers, and Option D (Campus recruitment) involves recruiting from colleges and universities.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) अनियत (कैज़ुअल) कॉलर है। ये वे व्यक्ति होते हैं जो स्वयं संगठन के पास आकर नौकरी के लिए आवेदन करते हैं। संगठन इनका डेटाबेस रखते हैं और रिक्तियाँ होने पर इनमें से उपयुक्त लोगों का चयन करते हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से पहचानिए कि नीचे दिए गए रेफ्रिजरेटर के चित्र में क्या दिखाया गया है:
questions.text_english: Identify from the following – what is shown in the picture of refrigerator given below?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Label. A label is the informational tag or sticker attached to a product that carries details about the product such as its features, usage instructions, warranty information, energy ratings, and other relevant data. The picture shows a refrigerator with multiple informational stickers/tags displaying details like Digital Inverter Technology, 10-Year Warranty, Power Savings Guide, and voltage specifications — all of which are part of the product label. A Brand name is the spoken part, a Brand mark is a visual symbol, and a Trademark has legal protection.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) लेबल है। लेबल उत्पाद पर लगाई गई सूचनात्मक पर्ची/टैग होती है जिसमें उत्पाद की विशेषताएँ, वारंटी, ऊर्जा रेटिंग आदि जानकारी होती है। चित्र में रेफ्रिजरेटर पर विभिन्न उत्पाद जानकारी के स्टिकर दिखाए गए हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा घटक 'वित्तीयन-निर्णय' को प्रभावित नहीं करता?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is NOT a factor affecting 'financing decision'?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Diversification. Diversification is a factor that affects fixed capital requirements and investment decisions, but it is not a direct factor affecting the financing decision (the choice between debt and equity). The factors that affect financing decision include: Fixed operating costs (higher fixed costs mean lower debt capacity — Option A), Cash flow position (better cash flow allows more debt — Option B), and Control considerations (issuing new equity dilutes control — Option C). Diversification primarily affects how much capital is needed, not the source of financing.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) विविधीकरण है। विविधीकरण वित्तीयन-निर्णय को प्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रभावित नहीं करता। स्थायी संचालन लागत, रोकड़ प्रवाह स्थिति और नियंत्रण प्रतिफल वित्तीयन-निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले कारक हैं।

questions.text: प्रतिभूतियों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखने के लिए निवेशकर्ता को एक संगठन के साथ डीमैट खाता खोलना होता है, जिसे कहते हैं: ________।
questions.text_english: For holding securities in an electronic form, the investor has to open a demat account with an organisation called ________.

options_english.B: Securities and Exchange Board of India

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Depository. A Depository is an organisation that holds securities of investors in electronic form. To hold securities electronically, an investor must open a Demat (Dematerialised) Account with a Depository. In India, there are two depositories: NSDL (National Securities Depository Limited) and CDSL (Central Depository Services Limited). SEBI (Option B) is the regulatory body, Stock Exchange (Option C) is the market where securities are traded, and Mutual Fund (Option D) is an investment vehicle.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) डिपोसिटरी है। डिपोसिटरी एक ऐसा संगठन है जो निवेशकों की प्रतिभूतियों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में रखती है। भारत में NSDL और CDSL दो प्रमुख डिपोसिटरी हैं।

questions.text: __________ का अर्थ है न्यूनतम लागत के साथ कार्य को सही ढंग से करना।
questions.text_english: __________ means doing the task correctly and with minimum cost.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Efficiency. Efficiency means doing the task correctly with minimum cost, minimum waste of resources, and minimum time. It is about the relationship between inputs and outputs — achieving maximum output with minimum input. Effectiveness (Option B), on the other hand, means doing the right tasks and achieving the desired goals, without necessarily worrying about resource utilisation. Management (Option C) is a broader concept, and Coordination (Option D) refers to synchronising the activities of different departments.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) कुशलता है। कुशलता का अर्थ है न्यूनतम लागत एवं संसाधनों के साथ कार्य को सही ढंग से करना। प्रभावपूर्णता का अर्थ सही काम करना है, न कि काम को सही तरीके से करना।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्य उच्च-स्तरीय प्रबन्धन का है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is the function of Top level management?

options.A: वे सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि उनके विभाग में आवश्यक कर्मचारी हैं।
options.B: वे वास्तविक कार्यबल से संवाद करते हैं एवं मध्य स्तरीय प्रबन्धकों के दिशा निर्देशों को कर्मचारियों तक पहुँचाते हैं।
options.C: वे संगठन के सुचारु कामकाज के लिए अन्य विभागों के साथ सहयोग करते हैं।
options.D: वे फर्म के जीवन के लिए व्यवसाय के पर्यावरण एवं उसके प्रभाव का विश्लेषण करते हैं।

options_english.A: They ensure that their department has the necessary personnel.
options_english.B: They interact with the actual work force and pass on instructions of the middle management to the workers.
options_english.C: They co-operate with other departments for smooth functioning of the organisation.
options_english.D: They analyse the business environment and its implications for the survival of the firm.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) They analyse the business environment and its implications for the survival of the firm. Top level management (such as the Board of Directors, CEO) is responsible for strategic decisions including analysing the business environment, setting overall objectives, and determining policies. Option A describes the function of Middle level management (ensuring departmental staffing). Option B describes the function of Supervisory/Lower level management (interacting with workers). Option C (coordinating with other departments) is a function of Middle level management.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। उच्च-स्तरीय प्रबन्धन व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का विश्लेषण करता है और फर्म के अस्तित्व के लिए रणनीतिक निर्णय लेता है। विभाग में कर्मचारियों की व्यवस्था करना और श्रमिकों से संवाद करना मध्य और निम्न स्तर के प्रबन्धन के कार्य हैं।
questions.topic: Levels of Management - Top Level Management

questions.text: संगठन चाहे आर्थिक हो, राजनैतिक या सामाजिक उद्यम की प्रबन्धन क्रियाएँ सभी में समान होती हैं। प्रबन्ध की विशेषता को पहचानिए:
questions.text_english: The activities involved in managing the enterprise are common to all organisations whether economic, political or social. Identify the feature of management:

options.C: प्रबन्धन एक निरन्तर चलने वाली प्रक्रिया है।

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Management is all pervasive. All pervasive means that management is required in all types of organisations — economic, social, political, religious — and at all levels within those organisations. The question states that activities of managing an enterprise are common to all organisations whether economic, political or social, which exactly describes the all-pervasive nature of management. Option A (Multidimensional) refers to management involving work, people, and operations. Option C (Continuous process) means it never stops. Option D (Dynamic function) means it adapts to changing environments.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) प्रबन्धन सर्वव्यापी है। प्रबन्धन की यह विशेषता बताती है कि प्रबन्धन सभी प्रकार के संगठनों में — आर्थिक, राजनैतिक, सामाजिक — आवश्यक होता है।

questions.text: 'मुद्रा बाज़ार' के सम्बन्ध में गलत कथन का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Choose the incorrect statement about 'Money market':

options.A: जिन मुख्य प्रलेखों में यह बाज़ार व्यापार करता है वह है ट्रेजरी बिल, व्यापार बिल, वाणिज्यिक पत्र एवं जमा प्रमाण पत्र।
options.B: चूँकि प्रलेख बहुत महँगे होते हैं अत: इस बाज़ार में लेन-देनों के लिए बड़ी मात्रा में धन की आवश्यकता होती है।
options.C: इस बाज़ार में भाग लेने वाले अधिकांशत: वित्तीय संस्थान होते हैं जैसे रिज़र्व बैंक ऑफ इंडिया, बैंक तथा वित्तीय कम्पनियाँ।
options.D: यह मध्य एवं दीर्घ अवधि प्रतिभूतियों में व्यापार करता है।

options_english.A: The main instruments traded in this market are Treasury bills, Trade bills, Commercial paper and Certificates of deposit.
options_english.B: In this market, transactions entail huge sums of money as the instruments are quite expensive.
options_english.C: Participation in this market is by and large undertaken by institutional participants such as the Reserve Bank of India, banks, financial institutions and finance companies.
options_english.D: It deals in medium and long term securities.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) It deals in medium and long term securities. This statement is incorrect. The Money Market deals in short-term securities with maturity of one year or less — it is a market for short-term funds. Instruments like Treasury bills (91-day, 182-day, 364-day), Commercial Paper, Trade Bills, and Certificates of Deposit are all short-term instruments. Medium and long-term securities are dealt with in the Capital Market, not the Money Market. Options A, B, and C are all correct statements about the money market.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। यह कथन गलत है। मुद्रा बाज़ार अल्पकालीन प्रतिभूतियों में व्यापार करता है, न कि मध्य एवं दीर्घ अवधि की प्रतिभूतियों में। मध्य एवं दीर्घकालीन प्रतिभूतियाँ पूँजी बाज़ार में होती हैं।

questions.text:
आशीष ने चादरें, तौलिए, रजाइयाँ, तकिये, कुशन, बाथ मैट्स आदि बेचने के लिए 2001 में 'कोर्टिको फैब्रिक्स' आरंभ की। आज यह एक सुप्रसिद्ध नाम है और सम्पूर्ण भारत में इसकी शाखाएँ उपलब्ध हैं। संपूर्ण भारत में कार्य के प्रबंध के लिए इसने आठ समूह बनाए – उत्तर, दक्षिण, पूर्व तथा पश्चिम भारत प्रत्येक के लिए दो समूह। विभिन्न समूहों के बीच सामूहिक प्रयासों का एक व्यवस्थित स्वरूप विकसित करने तथा उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति एवं कार्यों में एकात्मकता लाने के लिए आशीष काफ़ी समय लगाता है। समूह के भिन्न-भिन्न सदस्यों को कार्यों का उपयुक्त विभाजन सुनिश्चित करने तथा यह देखने के लिए कि सभी सदस्यों के बीच कार्य का निष्पादन सामंजस्य के साथ हो रहा है, वह अलग-अलग स्थानों पर अलग-अलग समूहों के बीच संतुलन बनाने का प्रयास करता है।

(b) उपरोक्त (a) में पहचानी गई अवधारणा के महत्त्व का कोई एक बिन्दु भी समझाइए।

'Cortico Fabrics' was started by Ashish in 2001 to sell bed sheets, towels, comforters, pillows, cushions, bath mats etc. It is now a famous name and its branches are across India. To manage the work all over India, it has eight teams-two each for North, South, East and West India. Ashish spends a considerable amount of time to develop an orderly pattern of group efforts among different teams and to secure unity of action in pursuit of a common purpose.
To ensure suitable allocation of tasks to the various members of the teams and to see that the tasks are performed with harmony among the members, he tries to balance the different teams at different locations.

sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the concept of management discussed in the above para.

key_points: Concept identified: Coordination
Coordination means synchronising and integrating the activities of different individuals and departments
It ensures unity of action in pursuit of common goals

sub_questions.solution: The concept of management discussed is Coordination. Coordination refers to the process of synchronising the activities of different individuals, groups, and departments so that there is unity of effort in the pursuit of common organisational goals. It involves ensuring that all group members work in harmony, their tasks are suitably allocated, and there is an orderly pattern of effort. As described, Ashish develops an orderly pattern of group efforts and secures unity of action — both hallmarks of coordination.

sub_questions.text_english: Also, explain any one point of importance of the concept identified in (a) above.

key_points: Any one: Unity of direction, Reduces conflict, Ensures organisational effectiveness, Integrates group effort

sub_questions.solution: One important point of Coordination is that it helps in achieving unity of direction. When different teams — spread across North, South, East and West India — work towards a common goal, coordination ensures that all their individual efforts are directed towards the same organisational objectives. Without coordination, each team might pursue its own goals, leading to conflict and waste of resources. Coordination binds all the activities together and ensures that organisational goals are achieved efficiently.

questions.text_english: State any three points of importance of staffing function of management.

key_points: Helps in finding and placing the right person in the right job
Ensures effective utilisation of human resources
Promotes growth and development of employees

questions.solution: The staffing function of management is important for the following three reasons. First, it helps in finding and placing the right person in the right job at the right time. By carefully recruiting, selecting, and training employees, organisations ensure that every position is filled with a competent individual who can perform the tasks efficiently. Second, staffing ensures the effective utilisation of human resources. A well-staffed organisation minimises waste of talent and ensures that the skills and abilities of employees are used productively towards organisational goals. Third, staffing promotes the growth and development of employees through systematic training and development programmes, which in turn leads to increased productivity and organisational effectiveness.

questions.text_english: State any three protective functions of 'Securities and Exchange Board of India'.

key_points: Prohibits fraudulent and unfair trade practices in the securities market
Controls insider trading and imposes penalties for such practices
Promotes fair practices and code of conduct in the securities market

questions.solution: Three protective functions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) are as follows. First, SEBI prohibits fraudulent and unfair trade practices relating to the securities market, such as manipulation of share prices and spreading false rumours to influence investor decisions. Second, SEBI controls insider trading — that is, it prevents people with access to unpublished price-sensitive information from using it to their advantage in the market, and imposes strict penalties on offenders. Third, SEBI undertakes measures to educate investors so that they are well-informed and can protect themselves from misleading statements and dishonest brokers.

केवलराम ने 1950 में राजस्थान में एक मिठाई की दुकान 'करामाती स्वीट्स' आरंभ की। इसकी अच्छी गुणवत्ता के कारण मिठाइयाँ सम्पूर्ण भारत में प्रसिद्ध थीं और लोग दूर-दूर से इसकी मिठाइयाँ खरीदने आते थे। जैसे-जैसे वह वृद्ध होने लगा, वह दुकान को अधिक समय तक नहीं चला सकता था। अत: उसने दुकान अपने एक पड़ोसी 'भोलाराम' को बेच दी। कुछ महीनों बाद आगम को और अधिक बढ़ाने के लिए 'भोलाराम' मिलावटी खोया एवं पनीर जैसे अनुचित व्यापार प्रथाओं में संलग्न होने लगा। उसने सोचा इस बारे में कोई नहीं जान पाएगा क्योंकि 'करामाती स्वीट्स' की लोगों की नज़रों में अच्छी छवि थी। धीरे-धीरे 'करामाती स्वीट्स' से खरीदी गई मिठाइयों का उपभोग करने के बाद लोग बीमार होने लगे, लेकिन उन्हें यह नहीं पता था कि वे कहाँ जाए और किसको इसकी शिकायत करें। राघव ने, जो इस गाँव का एक निवासी था, अभी-अभी अपनी पढ़ाई पूरी की थी। वह एक गैर-सरकारी संगठन 'मेरी वॉयस' का सदस्य भी था। उसने महसूस किया कि गाँव वालों को उन्हें उपलब्ध अधिकारों एवं राहतों के बारे में जागरूक किया जाना चाहिए। उसने गाँव वालों के मध्य वार्तालाप व व्याख्यानों की एक शृंखला के माध्यम से उनके हितों के संरक्षण के लिए उपभोक्ता अधिकारों के बारे में जागरूक करना शुरू किया।

questions.text: क्रोमोज़ोम बाह्य स्रोतीकरण से व्यापारिक सेवाएँ प्रदान करने वाला केन्द्र है, जिसके पास 40 कर्मचारी हैं और जो चिकित्सकों व अन्य स्वास्थ्य रक्षक सुविधाएँ प्रदान करने वालों द्वारा बोलकर लिखी गई रिपोर्ट्स को पाठ स्वरूप में परिवर्तित करने का व्यापार करती है। वे यह सुनिश्चित करते हैं कि उनके कर्मचारी कम से कम एक विदेशी भाषा तथा एक भारतीय भाषा में अच्छी तरह अनुभवी हों। यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि जिन रिपोर्ट्स का वह प्रसंस्करण कर रहे हैं वह सही हो, क्योंकि ये रिपोर्ट्स रोगियों की मेडिकल हिस्ट्री का आधार होती हैं, कर्मचारियों को भी आवश्यक प्रशिक्षण दिया जाता है। अपने कुछ कर्मचारियों के बारे में जल्दी-जल्दी शिकायत मिलने पर यह देखा गया कि वे संदेश को डिकोड करने में समस्या का सामना कर रहे थे क्योंकि वे उस भाषा में बहुत अधिक कुशल नहीं थे जिसमें सूचना प्राप्त हो रही थी। परिणामस्वरूप वे गलतियाँ करते थे जिससे संदेश का भिन्न अर्थ लगाया जाता था। इतना ही नहीं कभी-कभी बोलकर दी गई इन रिपोर्ट्स में कुछ तकनीकी शब्द भी होते हैं जिनका वास्तविक अर्थ भी कर्मचारी नहीं समझ पाते। इस कारण 'क्रोमोज़ोम' धीरे-धीरे प्रतिस्पर्धियों के हाथों अपना व्यवसाय खो रहा था। उपरोक्त स्थिति सम्प्रेषण की किन्हीं दो बाधाओं पर प्रकाश डाल रही है। इन बाधाओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
A Business Process Outsourcing centre, 'Chromosome' which deals in conversion of voice reports dictated by physicians and other healthcare providers into text format has 40 employees. They ensure that their employees are well versed in at least one foreign language and one Indian language. The employees are also given the required training to ensure that the reports are processed correctly as they are the backbone of the patients' medical history. On frequent complaints about some of its employees, it was observed that they were facing problems in decoding the message as they were not very proficient with the language in which the voice message was received. As a result, they would make mistakes causing different meaning to the message. Not only this, sometimes there were technical words used in voice reports, the actual meaning of which was also not understood by the employees. Due to this, 'Chromosome' was slowly losing its business to competitors.
The above case highlights two communication barriers. Identify and explain these barriers.

key_points: Barrier 1: Language barrier (Semantic barrier) - lack of proficiency in the language of communication
Barrier 2: Semantic barrier - use of technical jargon/words whose meaning is not understood by the receiver

questions.solution: The two communication barriers highlighted in this case are both types of Semantic Barriers. The first barrier is the Language Barrier. Employees at 'Chromosome' were not proficient in the language in which the voice messages were being received. As a result, they could not decode the messages correctly, leading to errors and miscommunication. Language barriers arise when the sender and receiver do not share the same language or do not have equal command over it, resulting in misunderstanding of the message's meaning. The second barrier is the use of Technical Jargon or Specialist Terminology. The voice reports contained technical medical words whose actual meaning was not understood by the employees. When the receiver does not understand the specific vocabulary or technical terms used by the sender, the intended message gets distorted, resulting in incorrect transcription and ultimately loss of business for 'Chromosome'. sub_questions.text_english: State any four limitations of planning.

key_points: Planning leads to rigidity
Planning may not work in a dynamic environment
Planning reduces creativity
Planning involves huge costs

sub_questions.solution: Four limitations of planning are as follows. First, planning leads to rigidity. Once a plan is made, managers tend to follow it strictly, which reduces their flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances. This can cause problems when the environment changes rapidly. Second, planning may not work in a dynamic environment. The business environment is full of uncertainties; frequent changes in government policies, technology, or consumer preferences can make even the best-laid plans irrelevant. Third, planning reduces creativity. Since managers and employees are expected to work according to predetermined plans, there is little scope for creative thinking or innovative approaches that may actually be more effective. Fourth, planning involves huge costs in terms of both time and money. Gathering information, analysing data, and formulating plans require significant investment of resources that may not always yield proportionate benefits.

sub_questions.solution: Strategy is a comprehensive and dynamic plan that outlines how an organisation intends to achieve its long-term objectives in the face of competition and environmental changes. It involves determining the general direction of the business, the allocation of resources, and the means of gaining a competitive advantage. For example, a company may adopt a strategy of product diversification to capture new markets. A Procedure, on the other hand, is a type of plan that describes the exact manner in which a routine activity must be performed. It is a chronological sequence of steps to be followed for handling a specific operational situation. Procedures ensure uniformity and consistency in operations. For example, the procedure for processing a customer's purchase order specifies the exact steps from receiving the order to dispatching the goods.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित आधारों पर 'विपणन प्रबन्धन दर्शन' की 'उत्पादन अवधारणा' तथा 'विपणन अवधारणा' में अन्तर्भेद कीजिए: (a) अर्थ, (b) मुख्य केन्द्र बिंदु, (c) साधन, (d) समाप्ति
questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Production concept' and 'Marketing concept' of marketing management philosophies on the basis of: (a) Meaning, (b) Main focus, (c) Means, (d) Ends

key_points: Meaning: Production concept focuses on availability and affordability; Marketing concept focuses on identifying and satisfying customer needs
Main focus: Production concept - production and distribution efficiency; Marketing concept - customer satisfaction
Means: Production concept - producing and distributing at low cost; Marketing concept - integrated marketing
Ends: Production concept - profit through volume; Marketing concept - profit through customer satisfaction

questions.solution: The Production Concept and Marketing Concept differ on the following bases. On the basis of Meaning, the Production Concept holds that consumers will prefer products that are widely available and affordable, so businesses should focus on producing large volumes at low cost. The Marketing Concept, in contrast, holds that organisational goals are best achieved by identifying the needs and wants of the target market and delivering the desired satisfaction more effectively than competitors. On the basis of Main Focus, the Production Concept focuses on production efficiency and wide distribution, whereas the Marketing Concept focuses entirely on customer needs and customer satisfaction. On the basis of Means, the Production Concept uses mass production and economies of scale as its primary tools, while the Marketing Concept uses integrated marketing activities — including product design, pricing, promotion, and distribution — that are all directed at satisfying customers. On the basis of Ends (ultimate goal), the Production Concept seeks profits through high volume sales, whereas the Marketing Concept seeks profits through customer satisfaction, repeat purchases, and long-term customer loyalty.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following functions of marketing: (i) Product Designing and Development, (ii) Standardisation and Grading

key_points: Product Designing involves creating product features and aesthetics that appeal to customers
Standardisation means producing products of uniform quality
Grading involves classifying products into groups based on quality

sub_questions.solution: Product Designing and Development is a critical marketing function that involves deciding on the features, shape, colour, size, and aesthetics of a product so that it meets customer needs and stands out in the marketplace. A good product design not only makes the product more functional and appealing to customers but also contributes to the brand image of the company. For example, an innovative design can make a product more user-friendly and aesthetically pleasing, thereby increasing its demand. Standardisation and Grading is another important marketing function. Standardisation means producing products of predetermined specifications and ensuring uniformity in quality and characteristics across all units. Grading means classifying or sorting products into different categories on the basis of quality, size, or other characteristics. For example, agricultural products like wheat and rice are graded into different categories. These functions help in simplifying buying and selling decisions, ensuring consistent quality, and building consumer trust.

key_points: Product - the offering made to customers
Price - the value exchanged for the product
Place - distribution channel
Promotion - communication to create awareness and stimulate purchase

sub_questions.solution: The four important elements of the marketing mix, often called the 4 Ps, are as follows. Product refers to the goods or services that a business offers to its target market to satisfy their needs. It includes decisions about features, design, quality, branding, packaging, and after-sales service. Price refers to the amount of money customers must pay to obtain the product. Pricing decisions are crucial as they affect revenue, competitiveness, and customer perception of value. Place (Distribution) refers to the activities that make the product available to the target customers. It involves decisions about the distribution channels, intermediaries, transportation, warehousing, and inventory management. Promotion includes all activities undertaken to communicate the benefits of the product and persuade customers to buy it. Promotional tools include advertising, sales promotion, personal selling, and public relations. Together, these four elements form a coordinated marketing mix that helps a company achieve its marketing objectives.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following characteristics of Principles of Management: (i) General guidelines, (ii) Flexible, (iii) Cause and effect relationship

key_points: General guidelines: principles guide managers but do not provide rigid prescriptions
Flexible: principles can be modified and adapted to suit different situations
Cause and effect: principles establish a relationship between cause and its effect

sub_questions.solution: General Guidelines: Principles of management serve as general guidelines for managerial decision-making and action. They do not provide specific or rigid prescriptions that must be followed in every situation. Instead, they offer broad direction and a framework within which managers can exercise their judgement. For example, the principle of Unity of Command says that each employee should receive orders from only one superior, but in practice, managers may adapt this based on organisational structure. Flexible: The principles of management are not rigid or absolute — they are flexible and can be modified, adjusted, and adapted to suit the needs of different situations, different types of organisations, and different cultures. Unlike principles of physical sciences that are universally fixed, management principles can be changed according to circumstances. A manager may increase the degree of centralisation or decentralisation based on the organisation's needs. Cause and Effect Relationship: Principles of management establish a relationship between cause and its effect. They explain the consequences of certain managerial actions. For example, if the principle of Fair Remuneration is violated, it will result in low motivation, high turnover, and reduced productivity. This predictive quality helps managers anticipate outcomes and make better decisions.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following techniques of Scientific Management: (i) Method Study, (ii) Differential Piece Wage System, (iii) Fatigue Study

key_points: Method Study: finding the best way to do a job
Differential Piece Wage System: efficient workers get higher wages per piece
Fatigue Study: determining the frequency and duration of rest intervals

sub_questions.solution: Method Study is a technique of scientific management that aims at finding the one best way of doing a job. It involves observing and analysing the various methods of doing a task to determine which method produces the best results with the least expenditure of time, effort, and resources. By eliminating unnecessary movements and selecting the most efficient procedure, method study helps to reduce cost and increase productivity. The objective of method study is to optimise the use of equipment, tools, and human effort. Differential Piece Wage System was developed by F.W. Taylor to motivate efficient workers by rewarding them more than inefficient ones. Under this system, two different wage rates are set for each job. Workers who produce more than the standard output per day receive a higher rate per piece (higher piece rate), while workers who fail to meet the standard receive a lower rate per piece. This system incentivises workers to work harder and produce more, while also penalising inefficiency. Fatigue Study involves determining the frequency, duration, and timing of rest intervals required during work. Continuous work leads to physical and mental fatigue, which reduces productivity and increases errors. By identifying the points at which workers need rest and the appropriate length of breaks, fatigue study helps in maintaining worker efficiency and prevents accidents caused by exhaustion.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following factors affecting the working capital requirements of a business: (i) Operating efficiency, (ii) Credit availed, (iii) Level of competition

key_points: Operating efficiency: better efficiency reduces working capital needs
Credit availed: more credit from suppliers reduces working capital needs
Level of competition: high competition may require more working capital for credit sales and stock

sub_questions.solution: Operating Efficiency refers to how efficiently a firm manages its operational processes. A firm with higher operating efficiency converts its raw materials into finished goods and collects cash from customers faster. This means it can complete its operating cycle more quickly, thereby reducing the amount of working capital tied up in the business at any given time. For example, if a firm can reduce its production cycle time or collect debts more quickly, it requires less working capital. Credit Availed refers to the credit facilities that a firm receives from its suppliers for the purchase of raw materials and other goods. When suppliers give generous credit terms — that is, allow the firm to pay after a longer period — the firm's need for immediate cash to fund operations is reduced. Longer credit periods from suppliers reduce working capital requirements because the firm has more time before it needs to pay for its inputs. Level of Competition refers to the degree of competition in the market in which the firm operates. In a highly competitive market, firms may need to offer more liberal credit terms to their customers (to attract and retain them), hold higher levels of inventory, and spend more on marketing. All of these increase the working capital requirements of the business. Conversely, firms in less competitive markets can demand cash payments from customers and maintain lower stock levels, thereby requiring less working capital.

sub_questions.text: एक कम्पनी के लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कारकों को समझाइए: (i) लाभांश का स्थायित्व, (ii) संविदात्मक प्रतिबंध, (iii) शेयर-बाज़ार प्रतिक्रिया
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following factors affecting the dividend decision of a company: (i) Stability of dividends, (ii) Contractual constraints, (iii) Stock market reaction

key_points: Stability of dividends: consistent dividend signals financial health
Contractual constraints: loan covenants may restrict dividend payments
Stock market reaction: dividend changes affect share prices

sub_questions.solution: Stability of Dividends refers to the policy of maintaining a consistent or steadily growing dividend payout over time. Investors generally prefer companies that pay stable and predictable dividends because it signals financial health and reliability. A company that has been paying regular dividends will try to maintain this pattern even during years of lower profits, since cutting dividends can send a negative signal to the market and erode investor confidence. Stability in dividends builds long-term investor trust and can enhance the market value of shares. Contractual Constraints arise when a company has borrowed funds under certain loan agreements or debenture trust deeds that contain restrictive covenants limiting the company's ability to pay dividends. For example, a lender may include a clause stipulating that dividends cannot be paid unless a minimum level of profits has been retained or until certain loan instalments have been repaid. Such contractual obligations directly restrict the company's dividend decision and the amount it can distribute to shareholders. Stock Market Reaction refers to the effect that dividend announcements have on the market price of a company's shares. If a company increases its dividend, investors typically interpret this as a positive signal of future profitability, which can lead to a rise in the share price. Conversely, a reduction in dividends is often seen as a negative signal, potentially causing the share price to fall. Management must therefore consider the likely reaction of the stock market before making dividend decisions, as changes in share price directly affect shareholder wealth.

key_points: Benefits of specialisation through division of work
Clarity in working relationships
Optimum utilisation of resources
Adaptation to change
Development of personnel

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of Organising are as follows. First, organising leads to benefits of specialisation. When activities are divided and grouped into different departments and assigned to specialists, employees develop expertise in their specific areas. This leads to higher efficiency, quality output, and innovation, as each person concentrates on a particular type of work. Second, organising brings clarity in working relationships. When duties, authority, and accountability are clearly defined for every position, employees know exactly what is expected of them, to whom they are accountable, and over whom they have authority. This clarity reduces conflict and overlapping of work. Third, organising facilitates the optimum utilisation of resources. By systematically allocating tasks, technology, and human resources, organising ensures that there is no duplication of effort, no underutilisation, and no wastage of resources — all resources are directed purposefully towards organisational goals. Fourth, organising helps in adapting to change. A well-organised structure makes it easier for an organisation to respond to environmental changes, technological advancements, and new challenges by re-grouping activities and reallocating resources without disrupting overall operations.

This is indicated by the line: 'He asked Nitin, the senior of the Project Head for a thorough investigation.' Step 3 - Comparison of Actual Performance with Standards: The actual performance was compared with the standard and a gap of six months was found. This is reflected in: 'the construction of the hotel was running six months behind schedule.' Step 4 - Analysing Deviations: Nitin identified the reasons for the deviation as huge absenteeism of workers and three defective machines out of ten. This is indicated by: 'inspite of huge absenteeism of workers, additional workers were not called' and 'three of the ten machines being used by the workers were defective.' Step 5 - Taking Corrective Action: Nitin ordered repair of the defective machines and directed the Project Head to appoint additional workers at attractive wages. sub_questions.solution: Two important points about the Controlling function of management are as follows. First, controlling helps in accomplishing organisational goals. By systematically monitoring actual performance, identifying deviations, and taking corrective action, controlling ensures that the organisation stays on track to achieve its planned objectives. In this case, without the controlling function, 'Memo Builders' would have missed its deadline and damaged its reputation for timely project delivery. Second, controlling helps in making efficient use of resources. When managers exercise control, they can quickly identify inefficiencies such as idle workers, defective machines, or wastage of materials, and take corrective steps. In this case, Nitin identified that machines were defective and workers were absent, and took action to rectify these issues, thereby ensuring that all available resources were used productively to meet the deadline.
